description: The pie chart illustrates the time distribution across two components of the Paper Copilot system: "Reduction" and "Efficient deployment." The chart is divided into two segments, with the larger segment, colored orange, representing "Reduction" and accounting for 60.9 seconds, which corresponds to 69.92% of the total time. The smaller segment, colored blue, represents "Efficient deployment" and accounts for 26.2 seconds. The percentages and time values are clearly labeled within each slice of the pie chart, with the "Reduction" segment being visually dominant due to its larger size. The chart uses distinct colors to differentiate between the two components, and the labels are positioned outside the pie to avoid overlap with the slices.
